text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and E for gains felt rewarding, but buying them back later at higher prices showed that a realized gain alone is not a reason to sell or rebuy; I should base decisions on my current view and portfolio needs.","A purchase feeling like a mistake—and a loss feeling painful—can tempt me to hold on for the wrong reason. I should assess each position without anchoring on its cost basis.","Recent price moves are random and do not reliably predict what comes next. With no clear reason to trade, holding my diversified portfolio and avoiding unnecessary activity can be reasonable."]}
